title: Derived Hom from a bounded-above projective complex
statement: Let R be a ring, let P^\bullet be a bounded-above cochain complex [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] of projective R-modules [lem-sc-bounded-above-projective-kprojective], and let L^\bullet be a bounded-below cochain complex of R-modules. Then the ordinary Hom complex Hom_R^\bullet(P^\bullet,L^\bullet) represents the derived Hom R Hom_R(P^\bullet,L^\bullet) [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. In particular its cohomology vanishes in all sufficiently negative degrees.
